lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section with slightly tighter packing on the anterior portion.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation occurs on the 3rd line from the posterior, splitting in the mid-lower torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant discontinuity observed on the 5th, 6th, and 7th lines from the anterior, appearing as shortened or dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Group of 5 distinct white spots on the lower posterior haunch with low spatial density.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align to form a brief horizontal geometric path.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white spot clusters on the cheek and lower jaw, and two distinct white patches on the bridge of the muzzle forming a partial chevron.
